title: Razorpay Payments on WhatsApp
tagline: Melancholy: the silent stories of abandoned carts. Shop. Don't abandon.
summary: A launch film where AI-generated imagery tells sad stories of abandoned carts, then turns them into stories of completion.

sections.label: The brief
sections.title: Launch Razorpay payments on WhatsApp.
sections.body: The campaign for Razorpay's payment solution on WhatsApp, led from concept to completion: coordinating teams, managing the creative process and using AI technology to make a campaign that is both innovative and emotionally resonant.

sections.label: The idea
sections.title: Melancholy.
sections.body: Brainstorms with the marketing and design teams produced three campaign concepts. The chosen one, "Melancholy", delved into the emotive narrative of abandoned shopping carts in the digital realm, each with a story echoing the silent plea, "Shop. Don't Abandon."

sections.caption: AI imagery, the script, and the Photoshop, After Effects and Premiere edit

sections.label: The process
sections.title: A solemn start, an upbeat turn.

items.title: Imagery
items.body: Midjourney created the visual cornerstone: unique, emotionally compelling images of the silent stories of abandoned carts.

items.title: Animation
items.body: Static images were brought to life into a flowing, dynamic narrative.

items.title: Voice
items.body: A professional voiceover artist added a solemn tone that turns optimistic and energetic as Razorpay introduces its solution.

items.title: Edit
items.body: Visuals and voiceover were edited together, with the visual style blending Razorpay blue and WhatsApp green.

sections.label: Results
sections.title: The highest engagement rates on Twitter and LinkedIn.
sections.body: With PR efforts, the launch video amassed over 95K impressions across social channels, with the highest engagement rates on Twitter (10%) and LinkedIn (4.5%). The accompanying blog captivated 6K+ unique readers, and 2000+ businesses expressed interest in the product, including a substantial number of existing Razorpay merchants.
